items.reason: The SpawnProcess type check skips killing hung workers before replacement, leaving duplicate flushers for the same shards. The additional shutdown observation describes the same incorrect type guard.
The shared join deadline causes the cleanup loop to break, skipping termination of remaining workers.
The added sleep is neutralized by the test's monkeypatch and provides no synchronization with the flusher thread.
The docstring incorrectly promises one process per shard despite distributing shards across a capped number of processes.
The wait_produce metric uses 'shards' while sibling metrics use 'shard', breaking consistent per-shard queries.
The incorrect multiprocessing.Process check skips killing SpawnProcess workers, allowing replacements to overlap with hung workers.
The restart guard does not recognize SpawnProcess instances, leaving old workers alive when replacements start.
The wait_produce timer publishes the shard identifier under 'shards' instead of the sibling metrics' 'shard' tag.
